Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied magnetism facts and context. Aluminum screws are effectively non-magnetic to a hand horseshoe magnet, while typical steel screws are ferromagnetic; thus a magnet (C) is the most reliable separator. The Planner incorrectly assumed aluminum might be significantly attracted and many steel screws would be non-magnetic, leading to the wrong choice (B) and prematurely finalizing without proper verification.
